'''2000 Dutch National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in European Go Centre, Amstelveen, Netherlands on 21 May 2000. [[Johan Haneveer]] won it. It is known from Johan Haneveer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d796">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ dutch-championship-21-05-00], DeckTech (Johan "Joh" Haneveer, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 May 2000
* '''Site:''' European Go Centre, Amstelveen, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 40
* '''Winner:''' [[Johan Haneveer]]
